supersedes: g3-criteria.json (v1, preserved unchanged — never edited in place)
supersession_reason: v1 named the half-split but not how the three tercile spreads aggregate into one per-origin number. Two precedents exist in this mission and they differ: G2-A weighted by stratum count, the committed R3 bi-dimensional leg took an equal-weight mean of the three tercile spreads. Worker stopped and asked before any result existed. Fourth condition in this mission to depend on an unnamed convention.

amendment_1_tercile_aggregation.decision: BOTH are computed and reported at every horizon and origin. Verdict condition (d) is evaluated on the EQUAL-WEIGHT mean.
amendment_1_tercile_aggregation.why_equal_weight_decides: Condition (d) exists to ask whether the bi-dimensional result established at 36 months survives at 12. The committed R3 robustness leg — which is the thing being re-tested — used the equal-weight mean and reported 5/5 positive origins. Scoring the re-test on a different aggregator would compare two different statistics and call it stability.
amendment_1_tercile_aggregation.why_count_weight_is_still_reported: It is G2-A's aggregator, so reporting it keeps this gate commensurable with the permutation gate, and publishing both removes the possibility of choosing an aggregator once the numbers exist.
amendment_1_tercile_aggregation.equal_weight_formula: for origin t: mean over the three B/P terciles g of (mean EXC over H_g - mean EXC over L_g), terciles with n_g < 4 excluded and their exclusion reported
amendment_1_tercile_aggregation.count_weight_formula: the same spreads combined as sum(spread_g * n_g) / sum(n_g) over included terciles

verdict_rules.G3_STABLE_ACROSS_HORIZONS: ALL of: (a) the pooled ICC coefficient is positive at all three horizons; (b) at the 12-month horizon, the pooled coefficient is positive with clustered |t| >= 2 and the per-origin sign is positive at >= 4 of 5; (c) rank IC mean is positive at all three horizons; (d) the equal-weight B/P-stratified high-minus-low spread is positive at >= 4 of 5 origins at the 12-month horizon.
verdict_rules.G3_HORIZON_SPECIFIC: the pooled coefficient is positive at 36 months but condition (b) fails at 12 months, or the sign of the pooled coefficient differs across horizons while remaining positive at 36
verdict_rules.G3_FAIL: the pooled ICC coefficient is negative at two or more horizons, or negative with clustered |t| >= 2 at the 12-month horizon
verdict_rules.unchanged_from_v1: conditions (a), (b), (c), the horizon asymmetry rationale, and the note that sector-neutral and large-cap estimates enter no threshold

carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.conventions: nearest-rank quantiles with no interpolation, tercile assignment order, half-split H = top ceil(n/2), ties by ascending symbol, Spearman on average ranks, the cluster sandwich
carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.frozen_vs_varying: the model is frozen; only the realized horizon varies over 12/24/36 months; the ICC is never re-solved
carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.overlap_structure: T_eff = T/h giving 5.0, 2.5, 1.67; raw n and T_eff reported beside every statistic
carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.primary_specification: R_h ~ const + BP + SIZE + FEPS1_over_P + ForecastSlope + ICC with origin fixed effects and origin-clustered SEs, momentum excluded from the primary and reported as a sensitivity
carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.required_reports: unchanged, with the tercile-spread item now requiring both aggregators
